text.en:
This Order shall take effect upon its promulgation.
Done in the City of Manila, this 14th day of February,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fourth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
